name: Some Beaches "North Beach" Grilled Pineapple Pulled Pork Burger
whyItWorks: Combines a smashburger patty and slow-roasted pulled pork on an artisan white bun; tasty in remission, though the fibrous grilled pineapple ring and sweet-tangy glaze make it heavier than a plain cheeseburger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For an easier-digesting version, remove the fibrous grilled pineapple ring after it adds flavor, or order "The Rock" plain cheeseburger instead.
watchOuts: Pineapple contains tough insoluble core/flesh fibers and bromelain acidity that can irritate active flares
